assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations, lightheadedness, and intermittent syncope
The symptoms are suggestive of supraventricular tachycardia and sick sinus syndrome
The diagnosis codes are I49.9, I47.1, and I49.5
The symptoms are paroxysmal in nature
There is a need for continuous rhythm correlation over an extended period
Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) is ordered
The service is intended to capture arrhythmic events and guide further management
The service is medically necessary to document intermittent cardiac rhythm disturbances described in the clinical indication
The service supports appropriate clinical decision-making
